heading: INT. WEDDING TENT IN A FLOODED MEADOW - NIGHT

units.text: INT. WEDDING TENT IN A FLOODED MEADOW - NIGHT
Fairy lights sag.
Rain drums the canvas.
Muddy shoes in a pile by the dance floor.
A three-tier cake leans, slightly.
MARISOL FERREIRA, 30s, in a ruined white gown, stands on a chair holding a champagne bottle.
Her groom, ADEBAYO KUROSAWA, 30s, soaked tux, stands below, arms raised to catch her.
Aunt BERNADETTE, 60s, clutches a tray of canapés.
The best man, CALLUM OYELARAN, 30s, tries to rescue the cake.
The flower girl, PIA, 8, sits under a table with a kitten.
Everyone, listen!
units.name: MARISOL

units.text: Rain hammers louder.
Nobody listens.
Marisol, come down.
units.name: ADEBAYO

units.text: I will not cry. I will not cry.
units.name: MARISOL

units.text: Somebody help me with this cake!
units.name: CALLUM

units.text: Not unless it floats!
units.name: BERNADETTE

units.text: The canvas sags.
Water pours through a seam onto the dance floor.
Callum, Bernadette, and Adebayo dive for the cake as one.
They collide, slide, and sit down hard in the mud.
The cake tilts, hovers, then lands neatly on Callum's lap.
Marisol stops.
Stares.
Starts to laugh.
To the wettest wedding in the county!
units.name: MARISOL
paren: to the crowd, lifting the bottle

units.text: Pia crawls out from under the table, kitten in her arms.
Adebayo reaches for Marisol's hand.
She jumps down into his arms.
